The '''Ap/11''' was a model of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] designed for use on vehicles produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] fitted one Ap/11 double laser cannon to each of a number of [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] as part of their modification into combat-worthy "[[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]]" shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. It could destroy an AT-ST with three shots but proved to have no effect on AT-AT's.

Another use for the Ap/11 was to arm the [[Freight-Loading External Rover/Legends|F-LER]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual">''[[Millennium Falcon Owner's Workshop Manual]]''</ref>
